app.name: Lillyjean
app.tagline: Track what you read. Share it with friends.

errors.credentials: Email or password is not right.

welcome.title: Track what you read. Share it with friends.
welcome.deleted: Your account is closed. It will be removed for good in 14 days.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. Several words together are easy to remember.
signup.terms: By creating an account you agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy.

verify.sentTo: If this address can be used, we sent a 6-digit code to {email}.
verify.codeHint: The code is valid for 15 minutes.
verify.missingEmail: Start again to get a code.

codeLogin.title: Log in with a code
codeLogin.intro: We will email you a 6-digit code.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: We will email you a 6-digit code.

libraryCard.title: Get your library card
libraryCard.intro: Pick a username. Friends find you with it.
libraryCard.usernameHint: 3–20 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dot and underscore

pledge.title: Your reading pledge
pledge.intro: How many books do you want to read this year?
pledge.changeLater: You can change this any time in Settings.
pledge.noGoalHint: Home shows the books you read, without a target.

home.comingNext: Book tracking arrives in the next release: search books, mark them as reading or read, and see them here.

profile.title: Profile
profile.booksRead: {count, plural, one {# book read} other {# books read}}

changeUsername.title: Change username
changeUsername.rule: You can change your username once every 30 days.
changeUsername.nextChange: You can change it again on {date}.

changeEmail.title: Change email
changeEmail.intro: We send a 6-digit code to the new address to confirm it.

changePledge.title: Yearly pledge
changePledge.intro: How many books do you want to read in {year}?

feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.intro: Tell us what works, what doesn't, or what you miss.
feedback.messageHint: We also save the app version and your username with it.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.question: Delete your account?
deleteAccount.explanation: Your account is closed right away. After 14 days your personal data is removed for good.

admin.title: Admin
admin.intro: Only visible to the admin role.

roadmap.title: What's coming
roadmap.intro: Lillyjean grows in small releases. This is what we plan next; your feedback can still change it.
roadmap.empty: Everything we planned is released. New plans follow soon.

bookSearch.label: Search by title, author or ISBN

addBook.author: Author

addBook.coverHint: A plain cover with the title is made for you

want_to_read.text: Find a book you would like to read and set it to Want to read.
